mechanism: Vitamin D deficiency is common in patients on TNF-alpha inhibitors like adalimumab due to reduced sun exposure, malabsorption in inflammatory bowel disease, and potential immunomodulatory effects; adequate vitamin D is necessary for optimal immune function and bone health in this population.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels in patients on adalimumab; maintain adequate vitamin D supplementation (800-2000 IU daily or as clinically indicated) to support bone health and potentially enhance immune regulation.
